name: MTR Veggie Upma
ingredients: Wheat semolina (72%), Interesterified vegetable fat, lodised salt, Dehydrated carrot (2.9%), Green chilli (2.1%), Ginger, Sugar, Maltodextrin (Corn), Curry leaves, Mustard, Bengal gram splits, Dehydrated onion, Anticaking agent (INS 551), Acidity regulators (INS 330 & 334), Natural and nature identical flavouring substance.
